title: Three days in Port Sorrel

lodging.name: Harbour Lane Guesthouse
lodging.address: 4 Harbour Lane, Port Sorrel, Fictional Isles
lodging.note: Breakfast included; luggage room after check-out.

budget_notes: A three-day museum pass covers the Lantern Museum, the Maritime Archive and the Tram Depot Gallery (fixture).
intro: An invented harbour city for testing: three days by tram and on foot, museums in the mornings, markets and lookouts in the afternoons, and a night market for the evenings.

practical.title: Getting around
practical.text: Trams and buses cover the centre; most sights are within a 25-minute ride of the guesthouse.

items.label: Transit pass
items.text: Three-day pass, sold at every station.

items: Trams run every 8 minutes until midnight.

practical.title: Good to know
items: The Maritime Archive is closed on Thursdays.
The Tram Depot Gallery is temporarily closed.
